Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.

Petitioner has approached this Court for mandamus commanding the opposite parties not to proceed with proposal of acquisition of land in question of the petitioner until determination of amount of compensation.
Till date, notification under the Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act of 2013 is not issued, therefore, the present petition filed at this stage is premature.
